raw_html: [[Legendary Nightmare Guard|Legendary Nightmare Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Nightmare Guard]]:''' On being hit or missed, this item has a chance to attempt to fear your enemy, ripping the life from them as if they were struck with a [[Phantasmal Killer]] spell. Enemies must make a DC 100 [[Will save]] versus the Fear or a DC 100 [[Fortitude save]] versus Death or be slain. Even if they make their save versus Death, they may still be feared.
